title: Accounts Payable and Receivable Officer
description:
Sewell Wallis is currently working with a fast-paced South Yorkshire retail business that is now looking for an Accounts Payable and Receivable Officer to join their finance team in Barnsley. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, takes pride in getting the detail right and is confident managing a varied transactional finance workload.

You'll play an important role in supporting the day-to-day finance function, taking ownership of Accounts Payable and Receivable, while also having the chance to be involved in month-end processes and financial reporting.

What will you be doing?

You'll be providing day-to-day support across a broad range of transactional finance duties, including:
- Performing daily reconciliations of company bank accounts
- Processing supplier invoices and credit notes, matching invoices to purchase orders and goods received, and maintaining an accurate purchase ledger.
- Obtaining and reconciling monthly supplier statements, investigating disputed invoices and liaising with suppliers to resolve queries.
- Reviewing and monitoring purchase orders and setting up new supplier accounts, ensuring bank details are verified in line with company procedures.
- Reviewing credit card expenditure and ensuring expenses are correctly coded and supported by the appropriate documentation.
- Supporting month-end processes, including accruals, prepayments, fixed asset accounting and balance sheet reconciliations.
- Assisting with financial analysis, reporting and the preparation of management accounts as your experience develops.
- Gaining exposure to audit and VAT-related processes while continuing to develop your technical accounting knowledge.

What skills are we looking for?
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including the confident use of SUMIFS and XLOOKUP and/or VLOOKUP.
- A good understanding of purchase ledger processes, supplier invoices and payment runs.
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate financial records.
- Strong communication skills

What's on offer?
- A competitive Salary of c 30000
- Excellent long-term progression opportunities
- Pension Contribution

Apply below or contact Jemima for more information.

To apply, please send your CV, quoting our reference and specifying which website you saw this position advertised on. Due to the high volume of applications, please accept that if we have not responded to your application within seven days, your application has not been successful. Sewell Wallis is a specialist recruitment company with a vast amount of experience in our industry. We offer permanent, temporary and interim recruitment support for accounting and finance, human resources and business support positions. We recruit at all levels within finance, from Purchase Ledger Administrator and Credit Controller level through to Financial Controller and Director positions. We are well situated to cover all of South Yorkshire, West Yorkshire and Manchester. Please visit our website for more information on accountancy and finance jobs and human resources or business support positions.

title: Assistant Credit Controller
description:
Assistant Credit Controller
Location: Barnsley

We are currently recruiting for an Assistant Credit Controller to join a busy finance team based at their head office in Barnsley.

This is a varied role within the credit control function, offering the opportunity to support customer accounts, resolve queries and work closely with both internal teams and the wider sales department.

Key responsibilities:
- Preparing applications for payment using Excel.
- Resolving customer queries and investigating account discrepancies.
- Working closely with the area sales team to support payment processes.
- Providing copy invoices, proof of delivery documents and completion certificates.
- Supporting cash allocation.
- Liaising with internal departments to resolve account queries.
- Completing account reconciliations.
- Providing general support to the wider credit control team.

What we are looking for:
- Excellent communication skills and a confident telephone manner.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Good attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- A positive, flexible and proactive approach to work.
- The ability to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines.
- A reliable team player who can communicate effectively with people at all levels

This would suit someone with previous experience in credit control or a finance administration role who is looking to develop their experience within a busy finance team.

title: Commercial Property Assistant
description:
Commercial Property Legal Assistant
Salary: Competitive, depending on experience

An established Yorkshire law firm is looking for a Commercial Property Legal Assistant to join its team in Barnsley.

This is an opportunity to support a varied commercial property caseload within a firm with more than 100 years of history. The team handles a broad range of work, including commercial sales and purchases, leases, new build matters, and investor and refinancing work.

What will you be doing?
- Providing day-to-day administrative and legal support to the commercial property team
- Assisting with commercial property sales and purchases
- Helping to prepare and organise legal documents and transaction paperwork
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, agents and other third parties
- Supporting the progression of matters and keeping files and case management systems up to date
- Managing correspondence, arranging meetings and maintaining accurate records

What are we looking for?
- Previous experience working in commercial property law is essential
- Experience in a legal assistant, secretary or paralegal role within a commercial property team
- Strong organisation and communication skills, with good attention to detail
- A confident and professional approach when dealing with clients and other contacts
- The ability to manage competing tasks and work well as part of a team

Applications from candidates without previous commercial property experience may not be suitable for this role.

Why apply?
- Join an established Yorkshire firm with more than a century of history
- Gain exposure to a varied range of commercial property matters
- Work in a firm that values a personal and approachable service
- Develop your experience within a specialist area of property law

If you have previous experience supporting commercial property matters and are interested in this opportunity in Barnsley, please get in touch to find out more.

title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
Location: Barnsley
Job Type: Permanent
Career Progression: Full training and opportunity to qualify

Are you a law graduate or an aspiring legal professional looking to build a career in property law?

A growing specialist property law firm in Barnsley is looking to recruit a Conveyancing Assistant to join its expanding practice. This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the beginning of their career who wants to gain practical legal experience, learn directly from an experienced legal professional and develop towards a more advanced role over time.

Previous conveyancing experience is welcome but not essential. The firm is happy to consider recent graduates and candidates with some relevant experience who have the right attitude, are keen to learn and want to build a long-term career in the legal sector.

The Role

Initially, the position will focus on supporting the day to day within the department. You will work closely with the firm's founder, receiving hands on training and guidance while developing your understanding of property law and the conveyancing process.

As your knowledge and confidence grow, there will be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities and progress into more advanced legal work, with the longer term possibility of working towards qualification.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Opening new files and completing initial administrative tasks
- Providing updates on matters and helping maintain clear communication
- Supporting the day-to-day administration of the property law practice
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring files are kept up to date
- Learning the firm's systems, processes and working methods
- Taking on additional duties and more advanced work as your experience develops

About You

The firm is open to applications from a range of backgrounds, including recent law graduates and candidates already working in legal administration or conveyancing.

You will ideally have:
- A law degree or some experience in a legal environment
- Strong organisational skills and good attention to detail
- Clear communication skills and a professional approach
- A willingness to learn and take direction from an experienced legal professional
- A positive attitude towards starting with administrative responsibilities and developing from there
- A genuine interest in building a long-term career in property law

Previous conveyancing experience is not essential. The firm is more interested in finding someone with the right attitude, commitment and potential to develop.

This is an opportunity to join a growing specialist property law practice where you can learn from the ground up, gain valuable hands-on experience and work towards developing a career in conveyancing.

If you are a recent graduate or an aspiring legal professional looking for a role with genuine development potential, apply today or contact Legal to find out more.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Elevation Recruitment Group is recruiting for a Credit Controller to join a friendly finance team in Barnsley on a 12 month fixed term contract, with a salary of up to £30,000.

This role would suit someone with previous credit control or sales ledger experience who is confident managing customer accounts, chasing outstanding payments and resolving queries. You will also provide support across purchase ledger when required, giving you the opportunity to gain exposure to wider finance activities.

The Role

Reporting to the Finance Team Leader, you will play an important part in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting cash flow and ensuring outstanding debt is managed effectively.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Managing customer accounts and keeping sales ledger records accurate and up to date.
- Raising sales invoices and credit notes.
- Monitoring aged debt and proactively chasing outstanding payments.
- Building positive relationships with customers to encourage prompt payment.
- Investigating invoice queries and payment disputes, resolving issues where possible.
- Producing aged debt reports and supporting cash collection activities.
- Preparing sales information and supporting documentation for financial reviews and audits.
- Providing purchase ledger cover, including processing supplier invoices and resolving discrepancies.
- Assisting with supplier statement reconciliations and payment runs when required.
- Supporting month-end activities, including reconciliations, debtor reviews and accruals.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and following internal procedures.

About You

To be considered for this Credit Controller role, you will have:
- Previous experience in a credit control or sales ledger position.
- Strong communication and negotiation skills.
- A good understanding of credit control processes and debt collection.
- Excellent numerical skills and attention to detail.
- The ability to manage your workload and meet deadlines.
- Good Excel skills and experience using finance systems.
- A team-focused approach with strong organisational skills.

This is a good opportunity for a Credit Controller or Sales Ledger professional looking for a 12 month contract, offering a varied role within a finance team and the chance to support additional accounting activities.

If you have the relevant experience and would like to find out more, please apply today.

title: Family Legal Secretary
description:
Family Legal Secretary

Location: Barnsley, South Yorkshire

Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

Job Type: Permanent

Hours: Full time, Monday to Friday

A well-established law firm in Barnsley is looking to recruit an experienced Family Legal Secretary to join its busy Family Law team.

This is a great opportunity for a Legal Secretary, Family Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant with previous experience in Family Law who is looking to join a supportive and established team.

The Role

Working alongside experienced Family Solicitors, you will provide day to day secretarial and administrative support across a varied Family Law caseload.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Providing legal secretarial support to Family Solicitors.
- Preparing and formatting legal correspondence and documentation.
- Typing letters, statements, applications and other legal documents.
- Managing diaries, appointments and deadlines.
- Opening and maintaining client files.
- Liaising with Clients, Solicitors, Barristers, courts and other third parties.
- Handling incoming calls and emails and dealing with client queries professionally.
- Assisting with the administration of Family Law matters, including divorce, financial matters and private children work.
- Supporting Solicitors with general administrative tasks and case management.

About You

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous experience working as a Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant within Family Law.
- Good knowledge of Family Law terminology and procedures.
- Strong typing, administration and organisational skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- The ability to manage deadlines and prioritise a busy workload.
- A professional and client focused approach.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Experience within a Family Law department is preferred, although candidates with strong legal secretarial experience and an interest in Family Law will also be considered.

What's on Offer?
- Permanent Family Legal Secretary position in Barnsley.
- Established and supportive Family Law team.
- Varied workload and regular client contact.
- Opportunity to develop your legal secretarial experience.
- Competitive salary based on experience.
- Friendly and professional working environment.

If you are an experienced Family Legal Secretary, Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant looking for your next opportunity in Barnsley or South Yorkshire, this could be an excellent opportunity to join an established legal team.

Apply now or contact Dan Craddock at G2 Legal Recruitment for a confidential discussion about the role.

title: Practice Bookkeeper
description:
We are working with an established accountancy practice in Barnsley to recruit an experienced Bookkeeper. The firm provides a broad range of accountancy, taxation and business support services to owner-managed businesses and SMEs across a variety of sectors.

This is an opportunity to join a supportive practice environment, taking responsibility for bookkeeping and VAT work across a varied portfolio of clients. The position would suit someone with previous experience in an accountancy practice who enjoys working directly with clients and managing their own workload.

Key responsibilities
- Managing bookkeeping requirements for a portfolio of clients across different sectors.
- Maintaining accurate financial records, including sales and purchase ledgers.
- Preparing and submitting quarterly VAT returns.
- Completing bank reconciliations and reviewing transactions.
- Preparing accounts to trial balance stage.
- Working with cloud accounting software, including Xero and QuickBooks.
- Liaising directly with clients to resolve queries and obtain information.
- Supporting the wider accounts team with year-end preparation.
- Ensuring bookkeeping records are maintained accurately and in line with relevant deadlines.

About you
- Previous bookkeeping experience gained within an accountancy practice.
- Good working knowledge of VAT and bookkeeping procedures.
- Experience using cloud accounting packages such as Xero or QuickBooks.
- AAT qualified, studying towards AAT or qualified by experience.
- Comfortable managing multiple clients and working to deadlines.
- Good communication skills and confidence dealing directly with clients.
- A methodical approach with strong attention to detail.

Salary and benefits
- Salary: £30,000-£35,000 per annum, depending on experience (full-time equivalent).
- Hours: Full-time or part-time arrangements considered.
- Location: Barnsley.
- An established practice environment with a varied client base.
- A role offering responsibility, client contact and flexibility around working hours.

The firm is open to considering both full-time and part-time applicants, making this a suitable opportunity for an experienced practice bookkeeper seeking a long-term position with flexibility and a good variety of work.
